onboarding.title: Sign in
onboarding.intro: Enter the Xtream Codes details of your IPTV subscription (server, username, password), or let them be filled in from your playlist.
onboarding.connected: Signed in. Importing the catalogue and the guide, this takes a few seconds…
onboarding.found: Details read from {source}: check them, then sign in.
settings.logoutTitle: Clear the catalogue and forget the credentials
settings.logoutConfirm: Sign out? The catalogue, the guide and the removed channels will be erased, and the credentials forgotten.
settings.tmdb: Movie and series titles and summaries are translated with TMDB (themoviedb.org) when a translation exists, otherwise the provider's are shown. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
settings.manageNote: Uncheck what you no longer want to see (Shift + click for a whole range). Nothing is final: just check it again, and your choices are kept when the catalogue is updated.
settings.pickGroup: Click a group to see what it contains, or start a search.
favorites.noneChannels: No favourites yet: pick a category above and click the ☆ star of the channels to keep here.
favorites.noneMovies: No favourites yet: click the ☆ star of the movies to keep here.
favorites.noneSeries: No favourites yet: click the ☆ star of the series to keep here.
guide.search: Search for a channel or a program…
channel.noGuide: No programme guide for this channel.
playlist.title: Playlist ({count})
player.idle: Pick a channel, a movie or a series.
sleep.title: Sleep timer: stop playback after a while
sleep.end: At the end of the movie or episode
sleep.done: ☾ Playback stopped by the sleep timer.
skip.buttonTitle: Skip the series' opening and end credits
skip.title: Series credits
skip.nowLeft: Time left from the current position
skip.note: Remembered for the whole series. ⏱ takes the current position. The end length is counted back from the end of each episode, whatever its duration.
player.subtitleSpeed: Subtitles made for a 25 frames per second version: slow them down to match this video (J key)
player.nextTitle: Skip to the next item in the playlist
player.refused: The provider refuses this stream (HTTP {code}): channel unavailable, or connection already used by another device.
subtitles.title: Online subtitles
subtitles.none: No subtitles found in this language.
subtitles.quotaNote: Green ones are the most likely to be in sync. Each download counts toward your daily limit (5 a day); subtitles you already downloaded stay available for free.
error.missingFields: Server, username and password are required
error.noResponse: No Xtream Codes answer from {server}: check the server address
error.notConfigured: Not configured yet: run the import
error.providerTimeout: the provider is not answering, try again in a moment
error.importRunning: Import in progress, try again in a few seconds
error.subtitlesQuota: Daily download limit reached, available again at {time}
error.subtitlesUnreachable: OpenSubtitles is not responding, try again in a moment
error.subtitlesEmpty: This subtitle file is empty or unreadable, try another one
update.title: Update
update.detail: Restart now to install it? Otherwise it will be installed the next time the app closes.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.note: Each profile has its own favorites, resume points and playlist. Only the administrator can open the settings. With several profiles, or a password, the app asks who is watching when it starts.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.noteAdmin: Sees everything and can open the settings: catalog, channels and groups, profiles.
profiles.noteStandard: Sees the whole catalog, or only the chosen groups (a Sports profile, for example). No access to the settings.
profiles.noteChild: Only sees the groups checked below. No access to the settings.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete the profile “{name}”? Its favorites, resume points and playlist will be erased.
profiles.noCatalog: The catalog has not been imported yet: the administrator must sign in first.
error.lastAdmin: At least one administrator must remain
error.deleteSelf: The current profile cannot be deleted
error.notAllowed: This content is not available with this profile
error.noProfile: No profile chosen: restart the app
versions.title: Other versions: quality, language
versions.note: Your choice is remembered: this version plays instead of the others, and replaces them in your favorites.
favorites.editTitle: Rename or delete this favorites page

favorites.deleteConfirm.one: Delete the page “{name}” and its favorite?
favorites.deleteConfirm.other: Delete the page “{name}” and its {count} favorites?

view.title: List layout
view.note: Set per tab. The display icon at the top of the column changes it for the current tab.
